topics.question: Some people think that universities should focus on providing academic knowledge, while others believe they should prepare students for the working world. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Advances in technology have changed the way people communicate. Some people believe this has had a negative effect on social interaction. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Many people believe that individuals cannot do anything to solve environmental problems and that it is up to governments and large companies to take action. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
The increasing rate of obesity in many countries is a serious problem. What are the causes of this problem and what measures could be taken to solve it?
In many countries, people are working longer hours and have less free time. What are the reasons for this trend and what are the effects on individuals and society?

Some people think that the best way to reduce crime is to give longer prison sentences. Others, however, believe there are better alternative ways of reducing crime. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Some people believe that globalization has brought many benefits to the world, while others think it has caused serious problems. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
Advertising has a powerful influence on people's lives. Some people argue that this is a positive development, while others believe it is negative. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

In many countries, women are now able to pursue careers that were previously only available to men. Some people believe this has had a negative effect on the family unit. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Traffic congestion in cities is a major problem in many countries. What are the causes of this problem and what measures can be taken to reduce it?

Some people think that children should begin their formal education at a very early age. Others believe that they should not start school until they are older. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
Some people think that space exploration is a waste of money and that these resources should be used to solve problems on Earth. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
